bermuda_manual.title: Add it to Bermuda yourself
bermuda_manual.description: Bermuda couldn't be changed from here, so the bottle will be set up without it. To track it, open Bermuda's Configure, choose Select Devices, and add {address}. If it isn't in the list yet, wait a minute for Bermuda to hear it.

abort.already_configured: This bottle is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No bottle heard. If the Hidrate app is open it's holding the connection, so close it and try again.

data.manage_reminders: Send glow reminders to the bottle
data.glow_always: Glow at every reminder, even when you're on track
data.glow_on_goal: Glow when the goal is reached
data.phone_relay: Let a phone read the bottle away from home

data_description.phone_relay: For the relay app on a phone that stays near the bottle. The next screen shows the address to give it.

phone_relay.title: Phone relay
phone_relay.description:
Give the relay app this address:

`{address}`

Anyone who has it can add sips to this bottle, so treat it like a password. It stays the same if you turn the relay off and on again.

probe.name: Probe the bottle
probe.description: Reads the bottle's firmware, battery and characteristics, with its serial and addresses removed so the result is safe to paste into an issue. Takes no sips and writes nothing.

bottle.name: Bottle
bottle.description: Which bottle to probe. Needed only if more than one is set up.

weight_seconds.name: Listen to the weight for
weight_seconds.description: Seconds to listen for the bottle's weight readings. Leave at 0 to skip this. It turns notifications on while it listens, and still takes no sips.
